title: Border War (2016)
note: 4 objectives; capped scoring encourages cautious play. Favor centre for holding your own and defensive placements; underdog twist rewards bold charges (+1 to hit if charged).

title: Focal Points (2018)
note: Objectives form a central cross; bias toward centre and the paired flank/home axes. Encourages contesting central cross objectives. Twist: underdog can change centre objective type.

title: Starstrike (2019)
note: Fewer clear lanes; objectives cluster in central lanes and terrain pieces can become objectives. Favor centre lanes with some forward bias for landing.

title: Shifting Objectives (2020)
note: Open map with shifting primary objectives each round. Keep flexible (scattered) placement and moderate centre presence to adapt to changing priorities.

title: Feral Foray (2021)
note: Six objectives, rewards raiding/scouting. Favor forward deployment to contest objectives early and enable raids. Twist: raid mechanics reward aggression.

title: The Jaws of Gallet (2022)
note: Five objectives with Hold One/Two/More scoring; objectives begin to collapse after turn 1. Emphasize centre control and hold positions; underdog may pull objectives starting round 2.

title: Battle for the Pass (2017)
note: Similar to Border War but short-edge deployment; armies push up sooner. Favor centre and defensive placements; twist: +2 control for non-hero units.

title: Scorched Earth (2019)
note: Classic Hold One/Two/More scoring. Deployment varies from older editions; encourage balanced coverage to deny enemy easy captures. Twist reduces enemy control score on a chosen objective.

title: The Better Part of Valour (2020)
note: Six objectives; unique Dominant mechanic for units securing objectives. Lean defensive and centre-focused to exploit dominant units; underdog gains +1 to hit vs Dominant units.

title: The Vice (2021)
note: Long-edge deployment pushing players to centre; objectives move/remove across rounds. Favor centre presence and flexibility to respond to objective changes; twist allows underdog to punish contesting units.

title: Close to the Chest (2022-2023 S2)
note: Small neutral territory and a designated primary objective. Prefer defensive placement near your primary objective; underdog can force opponent to change primary objective on a high roll.

title: Limited Resources (2023)
note: Resources and extraction mechanics influence objective control. Use balanced placement with slight emphasis on zones that enable resource extraction; underdog bonus to contested extractors.
